King Charles Funds Prince Andrew's Royal Lodge Repairs

King Charles III has provided funds to cover the £1.5 million to £1.8 million repair bill for Prince Andrew's residence, the Royal Lodge. The funds were reportedly lent to Prince Andrew by the King to address the costs associated with repairing the "dilapidated" former Royal Lodge home.
